title: Cross-layer KV map factorization over model pair and layer geometry
hypothesis: For two calibrated Pythia-to-SmolLM2 model pairs with fixed top-2 source-layer routes, a shared map basis plus a compact CP coordinate over model pair, source-depth anchor, target layer, and KV role will retain heldout next-token NLL within 0.5 nat of the full selected-map bank and within 0.25 nat of ordinary PCA coding while using at most half the full selected-map payload bytes.
prior_art_boundary: The screen uses ordinary unweighted affine ridge and PA236-style cross-layer map matching. It is not a CacheBridge reproduction and makes no attention-weighted calibration claim. PA237 informs the top-2 selection control only.
physical_object: Per-map affine KV translators over fixed source-depth anchors and all target injection layers for two ordered model pairs.
logical_multiplicity: Layer-to-layer KV handoffs selected by a frozen per-target-layer top-2 source-anchor route for each pair.
mirror_coordinate: Shared rank-r matrix-map basis plus CP coefficients over ordered model pair × source anchor × target layer × target KV role.

fixed_design.target_injection_layers: all 30 SmolLM2 target layers, identical for all representations
fixed_design.head_alignment: nearest relative KV-head index; source and target RoPE removed before fitting and target RoPE reapplied after key translation
fixed_design.role_axis: six roles = target KV head 0..2 × key/value
fixed_design.ridge_objective: ordinary unweighted affine ridge on token-aligned KV vectors; attention weighting is not used
fixed_design.route_selection: On disjoint route-selection prompts, choose the two source anchors with lowest mean normalized K/V reconstruction MSE per target layer; fixed equal 0.5 mixture weights. Routes are shared unchanged by full, PCA, CP, and nearest-depth comparisons where applicable.
fixed_design.cp_fit: masked squared reconstruction loss over selected route entries only; Adam; 300 updates; fixed initialization seed per world and rank

development.pca_rank_selection: smallest serialized PCA payload with development NLL <= full matched top-2 bank +0.50 nat and <= native +1.00 nat; if none qualifies, select lowest development NLL and mark the compression quality premise unsupported
development.cp_rank_selection: smallest serialized CP payload with development NLL <= full +0.50 nat, PCA +0.25 nat, and native +1.00 nat; if none qualifies, select the lowest-NLL CP rank

fresh.prompt_eligibility: 16-128 tokens and exact source/target tokenizer offset equality
fresh.selection: For each pair and split, deterministic pair-specific permutation of the first 48 eligible validation prompts; 16-prompt non-overlapping seed chunks. Test uses three disjoint seed chunks from the first 36 eligible test prompts.

controls: Native SmolLM2 target prefill and native-cache replay identity check
Fixed nearest-relative-depth full ridge translator, all target injection layers
Independent full ridge maps using the same frozen top-2 source-anchor routes
Shared PCA map basis with unconstrained per-map coefficients and the same routes
CP-factorized coefficients with the same basis and same routes
primary_metrics: heldout target next-token NLL by pair and seed
NLL delta versus native, full matched-route maps, and PCA control
actual serialized inference payload bytes including routes, map means/bases, codes or factors and metadata
map fitting, route-selection, basis/CP fitting, payload decode, cache application and target replay wall-clock
success_gate: In every fresh pair×seed condition, CP NLL is within +0.50 nat of full matched-route maps, within +0.25 nat of PCA, and within +1.00 nat of native target prefill; complete CP payload is <=50% of full matched-route payload and strictly smaller than PCA payload. If full maps themselves exceed native by >1.00 nat, report the transfer-baseline failure separately and do not claim a useful transfer win.
failure_gate: Any CP quality or storage gate misses in at least one fresh pair×seed condition, with integrity checks passing.

storage.common_model_weights: reported separately and excluded from marginal translator payload

scope: Two ordered Pythia-to-SmolLM2 pairs with the same target model; no unseen-pair generalization claim.
Affine ridge translator screen, one-token replay NLL, Wikitext-2 only.
Ordinary CP/PCA are native controls; no Mirror-specific claim from a compression pass alone.

protocol_amendments.before_replay: after the initial fresh run; ranks unchanged
protocol_amendments.reason: The first fresh runner measured serialized bytes but did not instantiate inference state from the serialized payload before quality evaluation.
protocol_amendments.change: Add deterministic full/PCA/CP binary decoders and replay the same frozen test prompt IDs from saved payloads; record decode time and NLL replay differences. No training, rank selection, or test-driven tuning is performed. The replay is a payload-integrity diagnostic on the same audit prompts, not an independent audit.
